__doc: A commune name a cahier writes wrongly, per record (scripts/_lib/geom_chain.py `_pinned_name`): record slug → the name as the zone section writes it → {name: the commune's name in IGN's layer, reason, verified}. Renamed and merged communes need no pin (INSEE's movements table and the former-communes layer resolve them).

ALCIETTE-BASCASSAN.name: Ahaxe-Alciette-Bascassan
ALCIETTE-BASCASSAN.reason: The cahier's alphabetical list of the Pyrénées-Atlantiques opens « ALCIETTE-BASCASSAN, AHETZE, AICIRITS-CAMOU-SUHAST » — the first word of Ahaxe-Alciette-Bascassan (64008) is missing; no other commune of the département ends so.

Saint-Maurice-ès-Allier.name: Saint-Maurice
Saint-Maurice-ès-Allier.reason: The commune's customary name: INSEE and IGN call it Saint-Maurice (63378). The cahier of AOC Côtes d'Auvergne (BO Agri, arrêté du 11 janvier 2024) writes « Saint-Julien-de-Coppel, Saint-Maurice, Saint-Sandoux » where this cahier writes « Saint-Julien-de-Coppel, Saint-Maurice-ès-Allier, Saint-Myon, SaintSandoux », and INAO's rows of Côtes d'Auvergne carry 63378; the French Wikipedia article of the commune (code commune 63378; neighbours Les Martres-de-Veyre, Mirefleurs, Busséol, Laps, Vic-le-Comte, all in this cahier's list) uses « Saint-Maurice-ès-Allier » itself.
